about: Every Elden Ring system the mashup touches, and how. One row = one hook/module in the DLL (fortring/src/systems/<id>.rs). er_api names the fromsoftware-rs type or the Windows API used.

columns.what: what it does for the player
columns.er_api: engine object / API it reads or writes
columns.when: game task group or hook point

rows.what: waits until the game window and reflection singletons exist, then starts everything
refuses to run unless launched offline through ModEngine2 (no EAC module in process)
keeps a separate save (ER0000.fnring.sl2) so the normal save never gets mod items
loads the Fortnite cache made by the setup tool; shows a clear message if it is missing
reads keyboard/mouse, hides the mod's keys from Elden Ring, presses Elden Ring keys for passthrough actions
knows when an Elden Ring menu, map, dialogue or cutscene is open, and hands control back
hides Elden Ring's HP/FP/stamina bars and quick slots (menus stay)
Fortnite over-the-shoulder camera with ADS
Fortnite movement controller (run, sprint, jump, crouch, fall damage); game gravity off while it drives
Fortnite 100 HP + 100 shield: HP shown as % of Elden Ring HP; shield absorbs damage first
rows.er_api: ChrIns data module hp/max_hp, compare per tick

rows.what: pickaxe + 5 weapon slots, ammo, materials, consumables; saved next to the Elden Ring save
rows.er_api: own JSON sidecar keyed by save slot
rows.when: on change / on Elden Ring save

rows.what: fire, spread/bloom, recoil, reload, ADS; damage via real Elden Ring bullets so enemies react, die and drop runes
rows.er_api: CSBulletManager::spawn_bullet, a repurposed BulletParam + AtkParam_Pc row, SpEffect attack-rate row set per held gun

rows.what: use bandages/medkits/shield potions with Fortnite timings
chests and ammo boxes across the map; E to search; loot pops out
rows.er_api: MsbRepository (anchors), CSActionButtonManImp prompt, own world-space draw

rows.what: dropped loot floats on the ground with rarity glow; E to pick up, swap if full
pickaxe swings ray-cast the world and give wood/stone/metal

grid build preview, place wall/floor/ramp; HP builds up; you can stand on, climb and take cover behind them; your bullets, rockets and pickaxe damage them. (0.1: enemies pass through builds, see build_pieces.about)
rows.er_api: own oriented-box collision in world::ray, own mesh draw

rows.what: draws Fortnite meshes (outfit, guns, chests, builds, pickups) in the world with depth occlusion
rows.er_api: D3D12 hook via hudhook pre-ImGui pass, scene depth copy

rows.what: hides the Tarnished and draws the Fortnite outfit with Fortnite animations at its position
rows.er_api: ChrIns model visibility flag, PlayerIns position/orientation

rows.what: the Fortnite HUD
plays Fortnite sounds (guns, chest hum, heals) with distance falloff
on death: Fortnite-style eliminated screen, then Elden Ring's own respawn at grace; inventory kept
writes FortniteRing.log for testing (boot, hits, chest rolls, harvest hits, build spawns)

_unverified_note: Each er_api is taken from fromsoftware-rs and the CS2 conversion field note; each must be seen working in the user's Elden Ring (2.7.1.0) before it counts as verified.
